buyer_groups.group_title: 1. 外資大戶：資金大挪移，狂掃低基期權值與傳產

stocks.description: 肖年仔，外資這次狂掃力積電 3.86 萬張，擺明就是看好晶圓代工的低基期反彈，想在底部卡位，這波半導體輪動，力積電被點火了。
面板雙虎之一的群創，外資也買超 3.77 萬張，這很明顯是看好面板報價有機會落底反彈，或者至少是資金從高檔避險轉往低價股的避風港。
鴻海這種大牛股，外資都買超 2.17 萬張，代表大戶對市場的防禦性需求很高，權值股穩盤，也是資金避風港的選擇。
聯電也被外資買超 1.45 萬張，跟力積電一樣，都是晶圓代工的低基期股，外資在半導體族群裡挑便宜的買，準備等風向變。
傳產龍頭中鋼，外資買超 1.62 萬張，這就是典型的資金從電子股撤出後，轉往傳產避險的動作，穩穩的賺，不求大富大貴。

buyer_groups.group_title: 2. 投信大戶（本土國家隊）：承接金融股，佈局電子旺季

stocks.description: 外資在倒金融股，結果投信狂買華南金 1.04 萬張，這擺明就是本土國家隊在承接，可能是在作帳，也可能是看好金融股的防禦性跟高殖利率。
兆豐金也是投信買超 0.75 萬張的重點，跟華南金一樣，都是外資倒貨，投信接刀，這就是內外資對作的經典戲碼。
第一金被投信買超 0.74 萬張，肖年仔，看到沒？投信就是愛金融股，特別是這種穩定的官股金控，當作基金的壓艙石。
投信買超旺宏 0.51 萬張，這檔記憶體股，外資也買，投信也買，看來大家都在賭記憶體產業的谷底翻身，準備迎接下半年的電子旺季。
投信買超臻鼎-KY 0.27 萬張，這就是典型的電子股佈局，PCB族群是電子產品的基石，投信在為下半年蘋果新機或AI伺服器題材做準備。

buyer_groups.group_title: 3. 內資主力與實戶：跟風面板與晶圓代工，短線操作避險

stocks.description: 自營商買超群創 0.30 萬張，跟外資一樣看好面板，但自營商的單通常比較短線，可能是看準短線反彈的機會，準備隔日沖或波段操作。
力積電也被自營商買超 0.26 萬張，這跟外資的思路很像，都是在低基期半導體股上找機會，但自營商的部位通常更靈活，隨時準備跑路。
友達被自營商買超 0.12 萬張，面板雙虎都被自營商點名，這代表市場對面板股的短線氣氛轉好，自營商也想來分一杯羹。
自營商買超聯電 0.14 萬張，跟外資一樣，都在晶圓代工這塊找機會，但自營商通常是避險盤或權證造市單，買賣動作要特別留意，別傻傻去接刀。
兆豐金也被自營商買超 0.10 萬張，這檔金融股，外資倒貨，投信跟自營商都接，顯示內資對金融股的防禦性價值還是有共識的。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略一：資金從高檔避險轉向低基期權值股
strategies.strategy_content: 肖年仔，你看外資大賣金融股跟緯創這種漲多的AI概念股，轉頭就去買力積電、群創、鴻海、中鋼這些低基期、有基本面支撐的權值股跟傳產龍頭。這就是大戶在市場高檔震盪時，把資金從高風險或漲多板塊撤出來，轉移到估值相對低、有防禦性的標的，準備等下一波行情發動，這不是看壞，是換檔操作啦！

strategies.strategy_title: 策略二：本土資金承接金融股與佈局電子旺季
strategies.strategy_content: 有趣的是，外資在倒金融股，結果投信跟自營商卻在接刀，特別是華南金、兆豐金、第一金這些。這代表本土資金對金融股的防禦性跟高殖利率還是有期待，搞不好是投信在作帳。同時，投信也買進旺宏跟PCB族群（臻鼎-KY、景碩、華通、聯茂），這很明顯是在為下半年的電子旺季做準備，特別是AI伺服器跟新手機的題材，這些都是電子業的基石。

strategies.strategy_title: 策略三：半導體與面板底部反轉預期
strategies.strategy_content: 外資跟自營商這次都同步買超力積電、群創、聯電、友達、旺宏這些半導體跟面板股。這可不是黑白買，這是大戶在賭這些產業已經來到谷底，未來有機會反轉向上。雖然國際上AI雲端公司Nebius還在燒錢擴張，但台灣的半導體跟面板，可能已經被視為景氣循環股的下一波啟動點，準備迎接復甦行情。

stock_uncle_insight.summary: 肖年仔，今天市場就是資金大風吹，外資從金融跟AI概念股倒貨，轉去低基期權值跟傳產，本土投信則在金融股接刀兼佈局電子，大家都在為下一波行情找避風港跟新題材，別傻傻追高，要學會逆向思考！

top_brokerages_analysis.uncle_logic: 高盛這外資大咖，狂掃力積電 1.35 萬張，這不是短線仔會幹的事。這擺明就是外資主力在佈局，看好晶圓代工的低基期，準備等半導體景氣回溫，這波是真外資的長線卡位，肖年仔別以為是隔日沖。
凱基台北這短線大戶，買超群創 0.12 萬張，這很明顯就是看準面板股的短線題材，準備隔天拉高出貨，肖年仔看到這種分點進場，隔天就要小心被倒貨，別傻傻去接刀。
元大投信買超華南金 0.47 萬張，這跟投信整體買超金融股的趨勢一致。這就是本土國家隊在承接外資倒貨的金融股，可能是為了作帳，也可能是看好金融股的防禦性，穩穩的賺，不求暴利。
摩根大通這外資大咖，大賣臺企銀 0.70 萬張，這跟外資整體大賣金融股的趨勢完全吻合。這就是外資在調整部位，把資金從金融股撤出來，轉往其他更有潛力的產業，肖年仔，別跟外資對作，小心被割韭菜。

english_professor_news.title: Amgen Q2 2026 earnings beat, raises full-year outlook, drops AMG 513

level1_blind.text:
Amgen reported second-quarter results on Tuesday that topped expectations, raised its full-year outlook, and disclosed it was ending development of an early-stage weight loss drug candidate.

The Thousand Oaks, California-based biotech earned $2.38 billion in the second quarter, translating to $4.37 per diluted share, a significant jump from the $1.43 billion, or $2.65 per share, it recorded in the year-ago period. On an adjusted basis, earnings came to $6.29 per share, up 4% year over year. Analysts had expected adjusted earnings of $5.62 per share, according to the Wall Street Journal.

Total revenue climbed 10% to $10.05 billion, compared with $9.18 billion in the second quarter of 2025, the company said. Product sales grew 9% to $9.54 billion, driven by volume growth. Analysts had expected revenue of $9.43 billion, according to the Journal.

Among the top performers, cholesterol drug Repatha posted sales of $953 million, up 37% year over year, while bone drug Evenity generated $714 million, up 38%. Rare disease treatment Uplizna grew 90% to $335 million. Cancer drug Imdelltra rose 115% to $288 million.

Amgen lifted its full-year 2026 guidance, now targeting total revenue in a range of $38.2 billion to $39.4 billion, which compares favorably to its previous forecast of $37.1 billion to $38.5 billion. On the earnings side, the company set an adjusted EPS target of $22.30 to $23.50, stepping up from its prior range of $21.70 to $23.10.

"Our six key growth drivers grew 26% year over year, generating nearly 70% of second-quarter product sales," Chief Executive Officer Robert Bradway said in a statement. "As we expand the potential of our existing medicines through new indications and advance the next wave of pipeline molecules through Phase 3, we remain confident in our ability to deliver growth well into the next decade."

Amgen also announced it is ending work on AMG 513, an early obesity candidate that had been undergoing Phase 1 testing. No explanation for the move was given. Amgen added that the existing Phase 1 trial would run its full course so that participants already in the study can be followed through to its conclusion.

With AMG 513 discontinued, MariTide stands as Amgen's sole remaining entry in the obesity space, advancing through Phase 3 trials that span chronic weight management, Type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular outcomes, and additional indications.

english_professor_news.title: Can Lockheed Martin (LMT) Capitalize on Surging Defense Demand Despite Rising Risks?
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
Emerald Wealth Partners, an independent asset and wealth management firm based in Zurich, released its Q2 2026 investor letter for the “Focused Equity Strategy.” A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. The Strategy reported a 0.8% gross return for the second quarter of 2026. Equity markets rallied after the first quarter’s Iran shock faded and oil prices reversed their spike, but the advance remained narrow and concentrated in cyclical semiconductor and memory stocks benefiting from supply constraints. The letter warned that investors were treating peak-cycle earnings as durable, while FOMO, IPO demand, and a US cyclically adjusted P/E ratio near 40 pointed to late-cycle market behavior. Long-term fundamentals are currently undervalued by the market, leading to underperformance in the strategy, notably due to the portfolio’s avoidance of low-quality momentum-driven semiconductor stocks, which boosted the benchmark this quarter. It remains focused on enterprise infrastructure, digital platforms, custom silicon, and networking businesses that hold customer relationships, workflow data, distribution, and efficiency advantages, which could allow them to monetize AI rather than be displaced by it. Please review the Strategy’s top five holdings for its key selections.

In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Emerald Wealth Partners Focused Equity Strategy highlighted Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT). Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) is an aerospace and defense company that engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, integration, and sustainment of technology systems, products, and services. On August 04, 2026, Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) closed at $589.33 per share. The one-month return of Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) was 11.62%, and its shares gained 35.52% over the past 52 weeks. Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) has a market capitalization of $13.01 billion.

Emerald Wealth Partners Focused Equity Strategy stated regarding Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"The ceasefire also weighed on Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT), which gave back part of a strong first quarter and detracted 55 bps. Our fundamental assessment is unchanged: conflict on European soil and Washington’s pressure on NATO allies continue to drive demand for the company’s systems sharply higher. But that demand comes with a twist — a business model that now requires heavier investment and carries more risk than Lockheed used to. Having trimmed the position close to its peak in the first quarter, we are comfortable with what we hold today."

Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) is not on our list of the 40 Most Popular Stocks Among Hedge Funds. As per our database, 83 hedge fund portfolios held Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) at the end of the first quarter which was 59 in the previous quarter. While we acknowledge the potential of Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. If you’re looking for an extremely undervalued AI stock that also stands to benefit significantly from Trump-era tariffs and the onshoring trend, see our free report on the best short-term AI stock.

In another article, we covered Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) and shared Greenskeeper Asset Management’s views on the company. In addition, please check out our hedge fund investor letters Q2 2026 page for more investor letters from hedge funds and other leading investors.

english_professor_news.title: Dear Nebius Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for August 5
english_professor_news.level1_blind:
Nebius Group N.V. (NBIS) has quickly established itself as one of Wall Street's hottest artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure plays. Riding the wave of surging enterprise AI spending, the AI cloud company has delivered triple-digit gains over the past year, fueled by explosive revenue growth, multibillion-dollar AI infrastructure deals, and soaring demand for its GPU-powered cloud platform. And now, the stock is back in focus. Piper Sandler recently initiated coverage on Nebius, just as investors gear up for a key catalyst on August 5.

The company is expected to provide an update on its Vineland AI data center, a flagship project that sits at the heart of its ambitious AI cloud expansion plans. The Vineland facility is designed to meet the rapidly accelerating demand for AI training and inference workloads. Investors will be closely watching for updates on construction progress, capacity, customer commitments, and the commercialization timeline, as the project's successful execution could significantly strengthen Nebius' long-term growth story.

Jeff Bezos Says He's Selling $1 Billion In Amazon Stock Every Year to Fund Blue Origin — 'It's The Most Important Work I'm Doing'

Apple's New CEO Is Bringing a Familiar Face Back From Retirement. The Shift Is Happening.

Nasdaq Futures Climb as Tech Rally Continues on Palantir Boost, U.S. JOLTS Report and SpaceX Earnings on Tap

Ahead of the update, Piper Sandler initiated coverage with a "Neutral" rating and a $224 price target. While the brokerage remains bullish on the long-term AI infrastructure buildout, it cautioned that Nebius is still in an aggressive investment phase where execution is everything. Analysts believe the August 5 update could be a pivotal moment. Strong progress at Vineland could reinforce confidence in the company's future revenue and cash flow, while any delays or execution missteps may weigh on the stock. So, with a major catalyst around the corner, here's a closer look at Nebius stock.

Headquartered in Amsterdam, Nebius is an AI cloud company building the infrastructure powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. As AI evolves from a research concept into a large-scale, real-world technology, the company provides a unified cloud platform that supports the entire AI lifecycle, from data management and model training and fine-tuning to production deployment and inference.

Built on deep in-house technological expertise, Nebius combines a strong engineering culture with proven experience in designing and operating large-scale platforms that perform reliably at global scale. Today, the company serves AI developers and enterprises across a wide range of industries, including healthcare and life sciences, robotics and physical AI, financial services, media and entertainment, retail, and more.
